title: Going deeper: The boundary survives an apology
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Own impact, keep reasonable limits and create a concrete path back into relationship and learning.
pressureLine: I'm sorry, but you made me shout.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: own the delivery and restate the limit calmly
principle: Model an apology that owns adult behaviour without shifting blame.
nextSentence: The reasonable boundary remains. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can own the delivery and restate the limit calmly.
keyLearning: Model an apology that owns adult behaviour without shifting blame.
